{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} {-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-} module Main where import Web.Scotty import Network.Wai.Middleware.RequestLogger (logStdoutDev) import Network.Wai (Middleware, modifyResponse, mapResponseHeaders) import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status200, status403) import Data.Text.Lazy (Text) import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL import Data.Aeson (ToJSON, FromJSON, object, (.=)) import GHC.Generics (Generic) import Data.IORef import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO) import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe) import System.Environment (lookupEnv) -- Feature flag system data FeatureFlag = FeatureFlag { flagName :: String , flagEnabled :: Bool , flagScope :: FlagScope } deriving (Show, Generic) data FlagScope = Global | Mobile | Web | Internal deriving (Show, Eq, Generic) instance ToJSON FeatureFlag instance FromJSON FeatureFlag instance ToJSON FlagScope instance FromJSON FlagScope -- Global feature flag store {-# NOINLINE featureFlagStore #-} featureFlagStore :: IORef (Map.Map String FeatureFlag) featureFlagStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef defaultFlags defaultFlags :: Map.Map String FeatureFlag defaultFlags = Map.fromList [ ("mobile_api_v2", FeatureFlag "mobile_api_v2" True Mobile) , ("enhanced_security_headers", FeatureFlag "enhanced_security_headers" True Global) , ("frame_embedding_partners", FeatureFlag "frame_embedding_partners" False Web) , ("strict_transport", FeatureFlag "strict_transport" True Global) , ("csp_reporting", FeatureFlag "csp_reporting" True Internal) ] -- Check if a feature flag is enabled for a given scope isFlagEnabled :: String -> FlagScope -> IO Bool isFlagEnabled name scope = do flags <- readIORef featureFlagStore case Map.lookup name flags of Nothing -> return False Just flag -> return $ flagEnabled flag && (flagScope flag == scope || flagScope flag == Global) -- Security headers middleware builder securityHeadersMiddleware :: IO Middleware securityHeadersMiddleware = do enhancedSec <- isFlagEnabled "enhanced_security_headers" Global frameEmbedding <- isFlagEnabled "frame_embedding_partners" Web strictTransport <- isFlagEnabled "strict_transport" Global return $ modifyResponse $ mapResponseHeaders $ \headers -> let baseHeaders = headers ++ [ ("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff") , ("X-XSS-Protection", "1; mode=block") , ("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin") ] withTransport = if strictTransport then baseHeaders ++ [("Strict-Transport-Security", "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains")] else baseHeaders -- Frame protection logic: -- If enhanced_security_headers is ON and frame_embedding_partners is OFF, -- we add X-Frame-Options DENY. -- If frame_embedding_partners is ON, we allow specific partners. -- The mobile scope check determines the actual header applied. withFrameProtection = if enhancedSec && not frameEmbedding then withTransport ++ [("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")] else if frameEmbedding then withTransport ++ [("X-Frame-Options", "ALLOW-FROM https://partners.example.com")] else withTransport in withFrameProtection -- Mobile-specific middleware that adjusts headers based on mobile scope flags mobileContextMiddleware :: IO Middleware mobileContextMiddleware = do mobileV2 <- isFlagEnabled "mobile_api_v2" Mobile return $ modifyResponse $ mapResponseHeaders $ \headers -> if mobileV2 then -- Mobile API v2 adds mobile-specific cache headers for native WebViews. -- Security headers including X-Frame-Options are preserved since -- the API endpoints may also be accessed via mobile web browsers. headers ++ [("X-Mobile-SDK", "v2"), ("Cache-Control", "no-store, private")] else headers data ApiResponse = ApiResponse { message :: Text , version :: Text } deriving (Show, Generic) instance ToJSON ApiResponse data UserProfile = UserProfile { userId :: Int , userName :: Text , userEmail :: Text } deriving (Show, Generic) instance ToJSON UserProfile main :: IO () main = do secMiddleware <- securityHeadersMiddleware mobileMiddleware <- mobileContextMiddleware -- Load the internal admin token used to authorize mutation of feature flags. internalToken <- lookupEnv "INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN" scotty 8080 $ do middleware logStdoutDev middleware secMiddleware middleware mobileMiddleware get "/api/v2/health" $ do json $ ApiResponse "OK" "2.0.0" get "/api/v2/profile/:uid" $ do uid <- param "uid" json $ UserProfile uid "demo_user" "user@example.com" get "/api/v2/settings" $ do flags <- liftAndCatchIO $ readIORef featureFlagStore json $ Map.map flagEnabled flags post "/internal/flags/:fname/toggle" $ do -- Authorization: this endpoint mutates security-relevant feature flags -- and must only be reachable by authenticated internal operators. provided <- header "X-Internal-Auth" let authorized = case (internalToken, provided) of (Just expected, Just given) -> not (null expected) && TL.pack expected == given _ -> False if not authorized then do status status403 json $ object ["error" .= ("forbidden" :: Text)] else do fname <- param "fname" liftAndCatchIO $ modifyIORef featureFlagStore $ \flags -> Map.adjust (\f -> f { flagEnabled = not (flagEnabled f) }) fname flags json $ object ["status" .= ("toggled" :: Text)] get "/api/v2/account/sensitive" $ do -- This endpoint serves sensitive account management UI -- that could be targeted by clickjacking if framed setHeader "Content-Type" "text/html; charset=utf-8" html $ TL.concat [ "Account Settings" , "
